subject: Quick priority check — throughput deck + 20m walkthrough?

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Throughput estimate + next steps from today's discovery

Sara / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same page and a clear next step.

What we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost per 1M requests while keeping 95th-p90 latency under 250ms for live matches.
- Typical payload: 1.2k tokens (avg), bursty traffic around 10am–12pm PT and 6pm–8pm PT.
- Data/workload constraints: must run in customer VPC for POC, encryption-at-rest, and audit logs retained for 90 days.

What I attached: a short throughput/estimate packet and a compact deck that maps configurations to expected cost & latency for your baseline workload. Files attached at the bottom.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) I'll walk you through the deck and the estimate in a quick 20-minute session to align on assumptions (I have slots below).
2) If the numbers look good, we can scope the POC (VPC private deployment + sample dataset) and propose a timeline + success criteria.

Available 20m slots (PT):
- Tue 11/10 10:00–10:20
- Wed 11/11 14:00–14:20
- Thu 11/12 09:30–09:50

If none of those work, share two times that do and I’ll book. Also, quick flag — if this is no longer a priority for Orchard AI in the next 4–6 weeks, just let me know and I won't keep nudging.

Attachments:
[Attachment: Redwood_Throughput_Estimate_Orchard_20261109.pdf (PDF, 230KB)]
[Attachment: RWD-inference-deck-compact-20261109.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Thanks,
